# DeathCraft

> DeathCraft is an Iranian, Persian-language Minecraft Java Edition server with the SkyMine and Arcade game modes.

- Server address: Play.DeathCraft.IR
- Game: Minecraft Java Edition, versions 1.8.x - 26.x
- Game modes: SkyMine, Arcade
- Language / region: Persian (fa-IR), Iran
- Official website: https://deathcraft.ir/

## Pages
- [Home](https://deathcraft.ir/): overview, how to join, FAQ
- [Rules](https://deathcraft.ir/rules/): chat, gameplay/PvP, trading rules and punishments
- [Server status](https://deathcraft.ir/stats/): live online/offline status and player count
- [About](https://deathcraft.ir/info/): official facts and links

## Official links
- Rubika: https://rubika.ir/DeathCraft
- Aparat: https://www.aparat.com/DeathCraft
